arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && python3 - << 'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys,time
def cfg(**kw):
    b=dict(early=True,overlap="first",buffer_packets=1024,idle_ms=0,max_streams_bidi=1024,max_streams_uni=1024,max_stream_data=65536,max_data=4611686018427387903,crypto_limit=65536,sent={"I":[],"H":[],"A":[]}); b.update(kw); return b
# 16 packets in a datagram: only final may be A. Use 15 I + 1 A, each 64 frames of PING/PADDING.
packs=[]
for i in range(16):
    lvl='A' if i==15 else 'I'
    fr=[{"type":"PING"} for _ in range(64)]
    packs.append({"level":lvl,"pn":i,"auth":True,"frames":fr})
evs=[{"t":0,"op":"key","level":"A","action":"install"},{"t":1,"op":"datagram","bytes":1200,"packets":packs}]
obj={"version":1,"traces":[{"id":"x","config":cfg(),"events":evs}]}
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','entry.py'],input=json.dumps(obj).encode(),capture_output=True)
o=json.loads(p.stdout); r=o['results'][0]
from collections import Counter
print('16x64 statuses', Counter(x['status'] for x in r['packets']), 'npackets', len(r['packets']))
# large data frames (2048 bytes each) 64 frames in one packet -> 128KB in one stream? exceed max_stream_data -> error
big="ab"*2048
fr=[{"type":"STREAM","id":0,"offset":i*2048,"data_hex":big,"fin":False} for i in range(64)]
evs=[{"t":0,"op":"key","level":"A","action":"install"},{"t":1,"op":"datagram","bytes":1200,"packets":[{"level":"A","pn":0,"auth":True,"frames":fr}]}]
obj={"version":1,"traces":[{"id":"x","config":cfg(),"events":evs}]}
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','entry.py'],input=json.dumps(obj).encode(),capture_output=True)
o=json.loads(p.stdout); r=o['results'][0]
print('bigdata packet', r['packets'][0])
print('conn', r['connection']['state'], r['connection']['code'])
PY
